headline: RapWire 24/7: Five distinct stories — Sept. 25, 2026 — 5 PM Pacific
body: Chief Keef returned to Chicago for his first headlining show inside city limits in roughly 14 years. Drake's appeal hearing over the dismissal of his UMG lawsuit tied to Kendrick Lamar's Not Like Us is set for December 4. Rockstar published tighter mod guidelines ahead of GTA VI. Shyne described a possible final hip-hop run, while Quavo and Offset confirmed plans for one final Migos project and tour honoring Takeoff.
caption:
1) Chief Keef just headlined in Chicago for the first time inside city limits in roughly 14 years, after the original date was postponed. The Northerly Island homecoming became a full-circle stop on his 2026 tour and a major moment for the drill pioneer. @ChiefKeef https://chicago.suntimes.com/music/2026/09/24/review-chief-keef-finally-returns-chicago-stage

2) A three-judge federal appeals panel will hear Drake’s challenge to the dismissal of his lawsuit against UMG over Kendrick Lamar’s “Not Like Us” on December 4. The hearing is about whether the case can be revived, not a ruling on the song’s underlying allegations. @Drake https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/drake-appeal-against-umg-over-kendrick-lamars-not-like-us-set-for-december-4-hearing/

3) Rockstar has published tighter mod guidelines ahead of GTA VI, limiting story expansions, cross-game map and asset combinations, ports, and outside monetization. The policy keeps Rockstar’s official Creator Platform at the center of multiplayer mod work and gives creators a clearer rulebook before Vice City returns. https://support.rockstargames.com/articles/5NVOAYjcTomO8v6SX2k76k/pc-single-player-mods

4) Shyne says his return to music may be his last hip-hop run, opening a new chapter after his years as a Belizean politician. In a new Brooklyn conversation, he connected the comeback to Flatbush, Caribbean identity, faith, and the legacy he wants to leave behind. @Shyne https://www.bkmag.com/2026/09/25/shyne-comes-home-interview/

5) Quavo says he and Offset are reuniting for one final Migos project and a tour meant to honor Takeoff. No release date or tour cities are locked yet, but the plan marks the first major Migos chapter built around the surviving members closing the circle together. @Quavo @OffsetYRN https://www.iheart.com/content/2026-09-10-quavo-confirms-final-migos-album-is-in-the-works/

@Rapwire247
